description:
A Windows 11 focused rebuild of GestureSign for touchpad, touchscreen, and mouse gestures.

GestureSign V2 is a Windows 11 focused rebuild of the classic open-source GestureSign project. It supports touchpad gestures, touchscreen gestures, mouse gestures, per-app device selection, gesture trails, ignore rules, tray controls, Smart Close, Smart New Tab, and optional Kando radial menu quick actions.
- Added French, Russian, Arabic, Spanish, and Portuguese localization across the main UI, settings, editors, dialogs, update notifications, and tray menu.
- Added automatic Windows display-language matching and manual language selection.
- Added right-to-left layout support for Arabic and safe English fallback for missing translations.
